test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 13 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. James is sitting second to the right of Peter. Charles is sitting second to the left of Peter. Sam is sitting third to the right of James. Tom is sitting second to the right of Sam. Ashley is an immediate neighbour of Charles and James. Who is sitting exactly between Ashley and Tom?
solution:
The pattern followed here is.

**Given: **Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. 

1) James is sitting second to the right of Peter.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5160346b62d4391261b4364978e98df9cd4e20d8a2cf7623bc6f8578a4c8c1c8.png] 

2) Charles is sitting second to the left of Peter.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3625af00ef4ce2f7efb0326be5ca2c1c0592a285b5a49595a37e4ee21843ff97.png] 

3) Sam is sitting third to the right of James.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f0083f41ea399424890c86361dc3d91cacc6c0d49f2b32af29b5061041c588d.png] 

4) Tom is sitting second to the right of Sam

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aef34f4e6232a8891c0a086971b7f72a3dfc67e6b9530fb278f69fa122481135.png] 

5). Ashely is an immediate neighbor of Charles and James.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/045bc5f7a3342f26e612022a40b2007817b270a9e0ef20461a43149727fec289.png] 

Clearly, James is sitting between Ashley and Tom.

Hence, the correct answer is " James".
